# Test fixtures

## LUKS headers (`fixtures/luks/`)

Produced by real `cryptsetup` 2.7.0 inside a Linux VM, because macOS has no
`cryptsetup` — device-mapper does not exist here, and Homebrew does not carry it.

**Why real cryptsetup matters.** If fixtures were generated by our own code, a
misreading of the spec would appear in both the writer and the reader and the
tests would pass while a real drive failed. These come from the reference
implementation, so they disagree with us whenever we are wrong.

### Contents

| Fixture | Exercises |
|---|---|
| `luks2-argon2id-512.img` | Standard Linux LUKS2 drive layout: aes-xts-plain64, 512-byte sectors |
| `luks2-argon2id-4096.img` | 4096-byte sectors — renumbers the XTS tweak |
| `luks2-argon2i.img` | argon2i instead of argon2id |
| `luks2-pbkdf2.img` | PBKDF2 KDF — the memory-cheap path |
| `luks2-metadata-64k.img` | 64 KiB metadata; backup copy at a non-default offset |
| `luks2-cbc-essiv.img` | Legacy aes-cbc-essiv:sha256, 256-bit key |
| `luks2-two-keyslots.img` | Two slots at 32 and 64 KiB — peak-memory selection |
| `luks1.img` | LUKS1 detection and clean refusal |
| `EXPECTED.txt` | `cryptsetup luksDump` ground truth, transcribed into assertions |

### Safety properties

- Each LUKS2 fixture is exactly `2 * hdr_size`, stopping **before** the keyslots
  area at 32 KiB. They contain **no wrapped key material**.
- Password is `test`; KDF parameters are deliberately weak (memory 32 KiB,
  4 iterations). Test data, not secrets.
- `cryptsetup luksDump` refuses a device smaller than the 16 MiB payload offset,
  so ground truth is captured from the full container *before* truncation.

### Regenerating

Needs Linux. From the repo root:

```bash
colima start --cpu 4 --memory 4 --disk 10
colima ssh -- sudo apt-get install -y cryptsetup-bin e2fsprogs btrfs-progs
colima ssh -- bash -s -- /tmp/luks-fixtures < tools/gen-luks-fixtures.sh
colima ssh -- tar cf - -C /tmp/luks-fixtures . | tar xf - -C fixtures/luks
```

UUIDs are random per run, so regenerating requires updating the assertions in
`core/tests/crypto_luks/luks2_real_fixtures.rs`.

## ext4 images (`fixtures/*.img`)

Built natively on macOS — no VM, no root, no mounting:

```bash
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/e2fsprogs/sbin:$PATH"
mke2fs -q -t ext4 -L LUKSTEST ext4-test.img
debugfs -w -R "write local.txt /remote.txt" ext4-test.img
```

`debugfs` splits arguments on whitespace, so source paths cannot contain spaces.
Destination names may contain UTF-8.

## Btrfs images (`fixtures/btrfs/`)

btrfs images **cannot** be built on macOS — there is no btrfs-progs for macOS,
and most of these have to be mounted to be populated. Built with real
`mkfs.btrfs` in the colima VM:

```bash
colima start --cpu 4 --memory 4 --disk 10
colima ssh -- sudo apt-get install -y btrfs-progs
colima ssh -- bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/btrfs && cd /tmp/btrfs'
colima ssh -- tee /tmp/btrfs/gen.sh < tools/gen-btrfs-fixtures.sh
colima ssh -- bash /tmp/btrfs/gen.sh /tmp/btrfs/out
colima ssh -- tar -C /tmp/btrfs/out -cf - . | tar -C fixtures/btrfs -xf -
```

Build a single fixture image:
```bash
colima ssh -- sudo bash /tmp/btrfs/gen.sh /tmp/btrfs/out fst-aged
```

| Fixture | Exercises |
|---|---|
| `plain.img` | Default geometry: 4 KiB sectors, 16 KiB nodes, metadata DUP |
| `compress.img` | zstd/LZO/zlib compression, holes, inline extents |
| `mixed-4k.img` | Mixed block groups, nodesize == sectorsize |
| `subvol.img` | More than one fs tree |
| `nonmixed-4k.img` | 4 KiB nodesize, dedicated metadata chunk |
| `sha256-4k.img` | 32-byte checksums (sha256 volume; write path refuses it — issue 44) |
| `fst-aged.img` | ~500 free-space-tree extents, ~80-90% of the single-leaf ceiling (16 KiB nodes) |
| `fst-multileaf.img` | 4096-byte nodes, free-space-tree root level >= 1 |
| `fst-bitmap.img` | At least one block group with `flags & USING_BITMAPS` |

`REQUIRED_BTRFS` in `tools/provision-fixtures.sh` is the authoritative list —
check there if this table drifts.
